n-e-acquired.line: Another district cleared, and resources acquired for the Empire!
n-e-acquired.heard: Another district cleared and resources acquired for the empire.

n-c-marches.line: The Host marches, to take back what is ours!
n-c-marches.heard: A host marches to take back what is ours.

n-e-repelled.line: The fauna tried to take back their town. The asset said no!
n-e-repelled.heard: The fauna tried to take back their town. The asset said no.

n-e-hollow.line: Queen's Hollow! Whoever holds it holds the planet. And the planet is ours!
n-e-hollow.heard: Queen's Hollow. Whoever holds it holds the planet, and the planet is ours.

faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/2.line: Whichever one you burn, brother. That is how prophecy works.
faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/2.heard: Whichever one you burn, brother, that is how prophecy works.

faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/3.line: "And those the sky takes up shall not be lost, but kept, each daughter in the cell of her longing."
faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/3.heard: And those the sky takes up shall not be lost, but kept each daughter in the cell of her longing.

faithful/the-comb-above/5.line: No PIT? Then what was the point of being GOOD?
faithful/the-comb-above/5.heard: No pit? Then what was the point of being good?

n-c-retaken.line: Our girls of the Host have taken back the town! The Growth is burning!
n-c-retaken.heard: Our girls of the host have taken back the town. The growth is burning.

faithful/the-comb-above/3.line: Then where is the Pit? Chapter twenty-two! Where are the wicked, burning, as it is WRITTEN?
faithful/the-comb-above/3.heard: Then where is the pit? Chapter 22. Where are the wicked burning as it is written?

faithful/theology-homework/0.line: To walk with us you must know the Book. Chapter one: the Seven Cities.
faithful/theology-homework/0.heard: To walk with us, you must know the book. Chapter one, the seven cities.

n-e-waste.line: And nothing goes to waste. Nothing at all!
n-e-waste.heard: And nothing goes to waste. Nothing at all.

n-e-sector9.line: Good news from Sector Nine! A brand-new world, and a brand-new asset hard at work!
n-e-sector9.heard: Good news from Sector 9, a brand new world and a brand new asset hard at work.

n-c-burned.line: The Growth is burned out! The Home Levy held the line!
n-c-burned.heard: The growth is burned out. The home levy held the line.

n-e-pilgrim.line: The Pilgrim Road is quiet this year. Travel advisories are in effect!
n-e-pilgrim.heard: The Pilgrim Road is quiet this year. Travel advisories are in effect.

n-e-foundry.line: At the Foundry Plains, war-beetle production has been permanently discontinued!
n-e-foundry.heard: At the Foundry Plains, war beetle production has been permanently discontinued.

faithful/the-comb-above/7.line: … We wish to lodge a complaint with God.
faithful/the-comb-above/7.heard: We wish to lodge a complaint with God.

faithful/the-hour/0.line: Brothers and sisters — HE IS HERE.
faithful/the-hour/0.heard: Brothers and sisters, he is here.

n-e-bells.line: Up on the Temple Terraces, the bells have finally stopped. Peace and quiet at last!
n-e-bells.heard: Up on the temple terraces, the bells have finally stopped. Peace and quiet at last.

faithful/theology-homework/1.line: We will read it to you on the air, brother, a chapter a night. Have a pencil ready.
faithful/theology-homework/1.heard: We will read it to you on the air, brother, a chapter a night. Have a pencil ready.

faithful/the-awaited-one/0.line: The Seventh City stands. When it falls, He comes.
faithful/the-awaited-one/0.heard: The seventh city stands. When it falls, he comes.

n-e-harbor.line: At Old Harbor, the local fleet has sailed for calmer waters. Very sensible!
n-e-harbor.heard: At Old Harbor, the local fleet has sailed for calmer waters. Very sensible.

n-e-spirited.line: The local fauna put up a spirited little fight. Aren't they something!
n-e-spirited.heard: The local fauna put up a spirited little fight. Aren't they something?

n-e-university.line: Their finest minds came to study the asset. The asset studied them right back!
n-e-university.heard: Their finest minds came to study the asset. The asset studied them right back.

faithful/a-broadcast-on-every-frequency/.line: …and they said the sign would come from the sky, and brothers and sisters, LOOK UP.
faithful/a-broadcast-on-every-frequency/.heard: And they said the sign would come from the sky. And brothers and sisters, look up.

n-e-complete.line: Clearance complete! On to the next!
n-e-complete.heard: Clearance complete. On to the next.

faithful/the-hour/2.line: Everything worked out. Everything worked out exactly as it was written.
faithful/the-hour/2.heard: Everything worked out. Everything worked out exactly as it was written.

n-c-every.line: Every street, every house, every last root of it!
n-c-every.heard: Every street, every house, every last root of it.

n-c-home.line: And the families come home again. Chins up, sisters!
n-c-home.heard: And the families come home again. Chins up, sisters.

faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/0.line: "And the river shall run with fire, and the terraces shall fall silent."
faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/0.heard: And the river shall run with fire, and the terraces shall fall silent.

n-c-part.line: And every sister does her part.
n-c-part.heard: And every sister does her part.

faithful/the-comb-above/0.line: Brothers and sisters, we have been DECEIVED. I woke in a hall of gold, chapter twenty word for word, and it is a MACHINE. The empties are up here too!
faithful/the-comb-above/0.heard: Brothers and sisters, we have been deceived. I woke in a hall of gold. Chapter 20 word for word, and it is a machine. The empties are up here too.

faithful/a-broadcast-on-every-frequency/.line: This is The Hour Is Near, on forty stations of the Last Hour Radio Network. And to the one who came down — I know you can hear me.
faithful/a-broadcast-on-every-frequency/.heard: Is the hour is near on 40 stations of the last hour radio network. And to the one who came down, I know you can hear me.

faithful/a-broadcast-on-every-frequency/.line: You are the sign. The world must end for the Awaited One to come. Let us help you end it.
faithful/a-broadcast-on-every-frequency/.heard: You are the sign. The world must end for the awaited one to come. Let us help you end it.

faithful/the-awaited-one/2.line: Then we will have misread the date. We have misread it before. It only makes us stronger.
faithful/the-awaited-one/2.heard: Then we will have misread the date. We have misread it before. It only makes us stronger.

say/the-voice-9d688caa.line: Homework, brother. Chapter nine: the Four Beasts. You are, we believe, beasts two and three.
say/the-voice-9d688caa.heard: Homework, brother. Chapter nine, the four beasts. You are, we believe, beasts two and three.

say/the-voice-e415d646.line: A test, brother. Which city falls on the day of the three lamps? … No. No. Read it AGAIN.
say/the-voice-e415d646.heard: A test, brother. Which city falls on the day of the three lamps? No. No. Read it again.

say/the-voice-791c9c41.line: …and the Visitor walks the terraces as it was written. Keep your radios on, brothers and sisters. Keep your donations coming.
say/the-voice-791c9c41.heard: The visitor walks the terraces as it was written. Keep your radios on brothers and sisters. Keep your donations coming.

say/the-voice-6d388481.line: Chapter twenty, brother: the Comb Above, where every sister taken up wakes in the hall she dreamed of. Summarise it for the congregation.
say/the-voice-6d388481.heard: Chapter 20, brother. The comb above, where every sister taken up wakes in the hall she dreamed of. Summarize it for the congregation.

say/the-voice-e2d495dd.line: Line one, you are on The Hour Is Near. "Is the Visitor the Deceiver or the Deliverer?" Sister — why not BOTH.
say/the-voice-e2d495dd.heard: Line one, you are on the hour is near. Is the visitor the deceiver or the deliverer? Sister, why not both?

say/the-voice-34268aff.line: The other faith says THEIR book foretold the Visitor first. Their book is a forgery of our forgery.
say/the-voice-34268aff.heard: The other faith says their book foretold the visitor first. Their book is a forgery of our forgery.

faithful/chapter-thirty-one/1.line: We will be writing chapter thirty-one. You are in it, brother. You are beasts two and three.
faithful/chapter-thirty-one/1.heard: We will be writing chapter 31. You are in it, brother. You are beasts two and three.

faithful/chapter-thirty-the-merchant/0.line: Brothers and sisters, do not weep. Chapter thirty: "And the Beast shall sup with the merchant."
faithful/chapter-thirty-the-merchant/0.heard: Brothers and sisters, do not weep. Chapter 30. And the beast shall sup with the merchant.

faithful/chapter-thirty-the-meek/1.line: It is WRITTEN. We misread the date again. It only makes us stronger. Keep your radios on.
faithful/chapter-thirty-the-meek/1.heard: It is written. We misread the date again. It only makes us stronger. Keep your radios on.

faithful/letters-in-a-field/1.line: The peace people write to you in a FIELD. Letters, in a field! Brother, we have forty stations.
faithful/letters-in-a-field/1.heard: Peace people write to you in a field. Letters in a field. Brother, we have 40 stations.

faithful/chapter-thirty-the-merchant/1.line: It is WRITTEN. We misread the date again. It only makes us stronger. Keep your donations coming.
faithful/chapter-thirty-the-merchant/1.heard: It is written. We misread the date again. It only makes us stronger. Keep your donations coming.

faithful/letters-in-a-field/3.line: Walk with us and every city you take is scripture. Our martyrs march in their armies. Our militants hold your ground.
faithful/letters-in-a-field/3.heard: Walk with us and every city you take is scripture. Our martyrs march in their armies. Our militants hold your ground.

faithful/letters-in-a-field/0.line: Brothers and sisters, a word to our Visitor, who is keeping bad company.
faithful/letters-in-a-field/0.heard: Brothers and sisters, a word to our visitor who is keeping bad company.

faithful/the-visitor-said-no/1.line: Open your purses. Every drop the Visitor makes from this day starts with the tithe of the faithful.
faithful/the-visitor-said-no/1.heard: Open your purses. Every drop the visitor makes from this day starts with the tithe of the faithful.

faithful/the-visitor-said-no/0.line: Brothers and sisters, the Visitor was TEMPTED. The peace people. The man with the dish. And the Visitor said NO.
faithful/the-visitor-said-no/0.heard: Brothers and sisters, the visitor was tempted. The peace people. The man with the dish. And the visitor said no.

faithful/chapter-thirty-one/0.line: It ended, brothers and sisters. Not with us. But it ENDED, and that is the main thing.
faithful/chapter-thirty-one/0.heard: It ended brothers and sisters, not with us, but it ended and that is the main thing.

faithful/chapter-thirty-the-meek/0.line: Brothers and sisters, do not weep. Chapter thirty: "And the Beast shall walk a while with the meek."
faithful/chapter-thirty-the-meek/0.heard: Brothers and sisters, do not weep. Chapter 30. And the beast shall walk a while with the meek.

faithful/letters-in-a-field/2.line: They think you came to heal the world. We know what you came for. It is written, chapter one to chapter twenty.
faithful/letters-in-a-field/2.heard: They think you came to heal the world. We know what you came for. It is written, chapter one to chapter 20.

faithful/a-man-who-plays-games/1.line: He says he does the maths. Brother, our Book did the maths two thousand years ago, and it came out the same.
faithful/a-man-who-plays-games/1.heard: He says he does the maths. Brother, our book did the maths two thousand years ago, and it came out the same.

faithful/a-man-who-plays-games/2.line: He will sell you, and sell us, and sell the Awaited One's seat in the front row. Come home to the Hour.
faithful/a-man-who-plays-games/2.heard: Will sell you and sell us and sell the awaited one's seat in the front row. Come home to the hour.

faithful/a-man-who-plays-games/0.line: To the Visitor, who takes calls from a man who plays games while the cities burn.
faithful/a-man-who-plays-games/0.heard: To the visitor who takes calls from a man who plays games while the cities burn.
